By 1000 CE, the Germanic conquest of Central, Western, and Southern Europe was complete, excluding only Muslim Iberia
'Germany' remained largely a conceptual term referring to an amorphous area of Central Europe
The Holy Roman Empire is referred to as the First German Empire
There was little cultural integration or national identity in the Holy Roman Empire
There was no real systemic continuity from the Western Roman Empire to the Holy Roman Empire
